name: opencode-go-vscode-chat
displayName: OpenCode Go & Zen Chat Provider for VS Code
description: Integrates OpenCode Go (subscription) and OpenCode Zen (free/pay-as-you-go) models into VS Code Copilot Chat. Go supports popular open-weight models with thinking/reasoning levels. Zen includes free models and pay-as-you-go access to Claude, GPT-5, and more. Both support tool calling, vision, and dynamic model discovery.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_go_analyze_image
languageModelTools.displayName: Analyze Image with OpenCode Go Vision
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze an image using OpenCode Go Vision model. Use this tool when you need to understand or describe the content of an image, extract text from images (OCR), or answer questions about visual content.

opencode.visionProxyModel.markdownDescription: OpenCode Go vision-capable model used to analyze images for non-vision chat requests and the shared image analysis tool. The default preserves the current behavior. Set this to another supported OpenCode Go vision model if you want a different proxy.
